summary: Your volatile, rebellious edge shows up through other people. You may encounter clashes, power struggles, or people who set you off. Or you become the unpredictable force others have to brace for.
body: Your volatile, rebellious edge shows up through other people. You may encounter clashes, power struggles, or people who set you off. Or you become the unpredictable force others have to brace for. The friction between your drive and sudden disruption plays out between you and someone else, in arguments that flare from nowhere and tempers that go off like a switch. The work is owning your own heat instead of waiting for someone to light it. You can be forceful without the explosion.
gift: At your best: bold and decisive, forceful without the blowup.
shadow: The trap: tempers that flare from nowhere, clashes you keep attracting.
integration: Let drive and anger and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
do: Notice what sets you off before it does
dont: Wait for someone to light the fuse
Let the temper go off like a switch
Pick the clash to feel alive
